title: CYBRIK transport peer-evidence denial v1
description: The typed denial body a relying party emits when transport peer evidence is not acceptable. It is fail-closed by construction (`fail_closed` pinned true, `degraded` pinned false) and it has nowhere to carry material: no thumbprint, no confirmation, no token, no certificate and no authorization property exists, and `additionalProperties` is false. The denial-class vocabulary TPE_* is deliberately disjoint from the accepted RES_*, SVC_* and BUDGET_* families. $id uses the RFC 2606 reserved .example documentation domain; it is a stable identifier, NOT an operational endpoint. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION — NOT IMPLEMENTED, v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA and not a bundle tag. Gate W2-K, ADR-0013.

denial_class.description: Exactly one TPE_* denial class. The catalog is closed: a denial that is not in this enum cannot be emitted, and every member is exercised by exactly one negative-semantic fixture.

message.description: Operator-facing text. Bounded, and structurally unable to carry material because no thumbprint, token or certificate property exists on this body at all.

fail_closed.description: Pinned true. A denial never leaves the connection in an accepted state.

degraded.description: Pinned false. There is no degraded, partially-authenticated or best-effort accept anywhere in this profile.
